select CustomerID, CustomerName,ActivityCredit,ActivityDebit ,case when OpeningBal > 0 then abs(OpeningBal) else 0 end as OpeningDebit ,case when OpeningBal < 0 then abs(OpeningBal) else 0 end as OpeningCredit ,ClosingCredit,ClosingDebit,ClosingAmount,ClosingAmountType from ( select finaltab.CustomerID, finaltab.CustomerName,finaltab.BrokerName,finaltab.codeCombinationID,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,SUM( CASE WHEN DocumentType not like '%Opening%' then ActivityCredit else 0 END) as ActivityCredit , SUM(CASE WHEN DocumentType not like '%Opening%' then finaltab.ActivityDebit else 0 END) as ActivityDebit ,SUM( CASE WHEN DocumentType like '%Opening%' then finaltab.ActivityCredit else 0 END) as OpeningCredit , SUM(CASE WHEN DocumentType like '%Opening%' then finaltab.ActivityDebit else 0 END) as OpeningDebit, SUM(CASE WHEN DocumentType like '%Opening%' then (finaltab.ActivityDebit - finaltab.ActivityCredit) else 0 END) as OpeningBal,
--sum(isnull(ActivityCredit,0)) as ClosingCredit, --sum(isnull(ActivityDebit,0)) as ClosingDebit
(CASE WHEN (sum(isnull(ActivityDebit,0)) - sum(isnull(ActivityCredit,0))) > 0 then abs(sum(isnull(ActivityDebit,0)) - sum(isnull(ActivityCredit,0))) else 0 END) as ClosingDebit, (CASE WHEN (sum(isnull(ActivityDebit,0)) - sum(isnull(ActivityCredit,0))) < 0 then abs(sum(isnull(ActivityDebit,0)) - sum(isnull(ActivityCredit,0))) else 0 END) as ClosingCredit
,(sum(isnull(ActivityDebit-ActivityCredit,0))) as ClosingAmount ,case when sum(isnull(ActivityDebit-ActivityCredit,0)) > 0 then 'Debit' when sum(isnull( finaltab.ActivityDebit-finaltab.ActivityCredit,0)) < 0 then 'Credit' end as ClosingAmountType from ( Select 'Opening' DocumentType ,CustomerID, CustomerName,BrokerName,CodeCombinationID,SUM(CreditAmount) as ActivityCredit,SUm(DebitAmount) as ActivityDebit from
